Definition: from G1342; to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent:--free, justify(-ier), be righteous.
BiblicalUsage: To justify is to declare someone righteous, to acquit them as if innocent. Paul insists we are justified freely by God's grace through the redemption in Christ, by faith apart from the works of the law. The result is peace with God, not a probationary pardon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that justification is the hinge of my whole hope. If God Himself declares me righteous in Christ, no accuser can reopen the case, and my standing rests on His verdict, not my performance.
